answer: To stop cloned skippers milking canal bounties, a convoy posts 22.7 POA in locker 4B, then splits an umber wax tablet: helm keeps UM-A, lockkeeper keeps UM-B. Mid-voyage at km 18.4 the helm dips UM-A; UM-B must show the same 6-groove bite within 14 min. A forge clerk at gate FG-11 laser-measures both halves and logs two witnesses. Bite mismatch over 0.7 mm burns 8.4 POA and freezes the skipper 5 epochs. If either half is late past 14 min, the voyage is voided and 19.1 POA refunds after 1 epoch minus a 1.6 POA late fee.
